title: Starting drums at seven, school band, Manuel Cruz and piano gigs
summary: He began drums around age seven, joined the school band at ten, and played piano on gigs with Manuel Cruz while trombone was still not in demand.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well how old were you when you started on your drums?

Well, Bill I tell you, I guess I was around about seven man, because my brother's starting up. See, oh I couldn't get to school too well. And, uh, my cousin, she was a teacher at Carpet Christie, but she used to come help me. Well you know like these days, if a kid had polio now, well they make it possible for you to go back as well as in Fort Worth, which we were poor, you know. Yeah. So when I was about, I'd say about ten, well that's when I started playing in the school band, but I did have an idea about it. Yeah. And I had a piano and all, I had everything to work with. Yeah, see, and, uh, I was doing pretty well.

Um, were there any other, uh, jazz musicians, that is the musicians that later became jazz musicians in your orchestra or band at school? Do you remember who else was in there, anybody else? Maybe some of the older kids too, or different ones who had become musicians?
Well, it really built that out, because remember one fella still playing, his name is Manuel Cruz. They had some other fellas, but they're not, uh, they're not like in it like I am.
Oh, by the way, is Manuel Cruz still around town? Yeah, he is. I haven't seen him for a long time, he used to play clarinet and play some trumpet too.
Well he was playing trumpet dance.
Yeah, I heard him play trumpet in the parade.

Yeah, because a lot of time him and I, well you see, Bourbon Street wasn't, uh, wasn't the street dance. No. Out here. Well I used to play piano with Manuel on a lot of gigs, see. I didn't know how to read the piano music, but I could read the cymbals, you know. I mean not fast enough. You could get the chords. Yeah, I can read all the cymbals no matter how they can, you see. But still, I was still learning trombones, see, because trombones wasn't in demand, see.
